label: BETTER
unit_rule: distinct (size, block) configurations with >=2/3 replicates passing the corrected gate
ci_basis: configurations (mean of 3 replicates per config), not rows
label_rule: INSUFFICIENT if n_units < 8 (paired bootstrap needs >=8 usable distinct configs for a stable MDE); BETTER if paired CI hi<0; WORSE if paired CI lo>0.10; TIE if paired CI hi<=0.10; UNRESOLVED otherwise. Threshold 8 differs from u5r4's n_usable<3 (u5r4 tests a single config, no paired bootstrap).
noise_bound_note: per-config within-std is max_within_std_us (us, from empty-baseline p05-p95). The reported noise_bound_us is the median over the 9 usable configs. Median within-config stdev of log10(kernel_us) is not stored (per-trial kernel_us not retained); max_within_std_us is the conservative substitute.

mechanism_probe.label: MECHANISM PROBE
mechanism_probe.note: grid-stride separates block size from grid coverage at fixed problem size; does not enter the size/block arm's n_eff (12 configs).

finding: BETTER means GBT beats the linear floor in the paired ln-space comparison; it does NOT mean GBT is accurate: GBT MAE is 0.7366 in ln space (~2x multiplicative error) and the linear floor MAE diverges at 4.6876. The label reflects relative ranking, not absolute accuracy.
gate: none -- no gate-run record exists for this bead; its provenance is the unit suite recorded at .lab/runs/gpu-sim-5uu9/unit-suite.log (1163 tests ok, 19 skipped, at ab5f11da), so this artifact is reported as unverifiable instead of claiming a gate citation
